antihypertensive_sbp.display_name: Antihypertensive medication use -> systolic blood pressure

treatment.label: Currently taking prescribed antihypertensive medicine
treatment.timing: current medication use initiated before the MEC blood-pressure measurement
treatment.coding: 1 currently taking prescribed medicine; 0 not currently taking, among participants with BPQ020=1
treatment.medical_context: Medication is prescribed in response to prior hypertension severity and cardiovascular risk and is intended to lower current systolic blood pressure.
semantic_constraints: For the target intervention, T may cause Y; current Y must not be oriented as the cause of already initiated T.
Historical disease severity may cause both T and Y and represents confounding by indication.

outcome.label: Mean systolic blood pressure
outcome.timing: MEC examination after current medication status was reported
outcome.coding: mean of available systolic readings in mmHg
outcome.medical_context: Arterial pressure during cardiac contraction; lower values generally indicate better blood-pressure control in this cohort.
semantic_constraints: Y is the terminal outcome for local uplift discovery and cannot cause predetermined baseline attributes.
T -> Y is fixed by the intervention query.

BPQ020.medical_context: All included participants have BPQ020=1, so this node contains no within-cohort information and should not enter graph learning or adjustment.

treatment.label: Currently following medical advice to take prescribed cholesterol-lowering medicine
treatment.timing: current medication use initiated before the laboratory cholesterol measurement
treatment.coding: 1 currently following prescribed-medicine advice; 0 not following, among eligible participants with BPQ080=1
treatment.medical_context: Treatment is selected partly because of prior lipid severity and cardiovascular risk and is intended to lower current circulating cholesterol.
semantic_constraints: For the target intervention, T may cause Y; current Y must not be oriented as the cause of already initiated T.
Prior lipid severity and cardiovascular disease may cause both T and Y, creating confounding by indication.

outcome.label: Serum total cholesterol
outcome.timing: MEC laboratory examination after current medication status was reported
outcome.medical_context: Direct laboratory measure used in cardiovascular risk assessment and treatment monitoring; lower values generally indicate stronger lipid control in this cohort.
semantic_constraints: Y is the terminal outcome for local uplift discovery and cannot cause predetermined baseline attributes.
T -> Y is fixed by the intervention query.
